scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w @roadcred/api" "npm run dev -w @roadcred/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @roadcred/shared && npm run build -w @roadcred/api && npm run build -w @roadcred/web
scripts.build:pages: npm run build -w @roadcred/shared && npm run build -w @roadcred/api && npm run export:pages-fixture && npm run build -w @roadcred/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @roadcred/shared && npm run typecheck -w @roadcred/api && npm run typecheck -w @roadcred/web
